# ukdatakit

> ukdatakit makes pay-per-result tools for official UK public data, available on the Apify Store. Results export to JSON, CSV or Excel, or by API. Pricing is per result and shown on Apify. Apify profile: https://apify.com/ukdatakit

## Tools

- [UK House Prices](https://ukdatakit.com/#uk-house-prices): sold house prices from HM Land Registry Price Paid Data by full postcode, sector or outcode, with date filters and a run summary including the median price. One row per sale: price, date, full address, postcode, property type, new build, tenure, transaction category and a link to the Land Registry record. On Apify: https://apify.com/ukdatakit/uk-house-prices
- [UK Visa Sponsor Register](https://ukdatakit.com/#uk-visa-sponsor-register): search the Home Office register of licensed sponsors by organisation name, town and route; check whether an employer can sponsor Skilled Worker visas. One row per sponsor: name, town, county, routes, types and ratings, Skilled Worker flag, register date and a link to the GOV.UK CSV. Also has a change monitor mode for sponsors added to or removed from the register. On Apify: https://apify.com/ukdatakit/uk-visa-sponsor-register
- [UK Planning Constraints Checker](https://ukdatakit.com/#uk-planning-constraints): bulk-check postcodes or coordinates in England for conservation areas, listed buildings (and nearby listed buildings with grade and distance), Article 4 directions, tree preservation orders, flood zone 2/3, green belt, national parks, National Landscapes, SSSIs, scheduled monuments and World Heritage Sites. Flags when a council has not published a layer. Source: planning.data.gov.uk (OGL). On Apify: https://apify.com/ukdatakit/uk-planning-constraints
- [Companies House ID Verification Checker](https://ukdatakit.com/#uk-companies-house-id-verification): check which directors and PSCs have verified their identity under ECCTA, with due dates per person. Source: Companies House public data API. On Apify: https://apify.com/ukdatakit/uk-companies-house-id-verification

## Other

- [Custom data jobs](https://ukdatakit.com/#custom): tailored feeds from official UK open data. Contact vora+ukdatakit@mail.grokbot.com.
- Data licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 (Crown copyright).
